evaluator: Fictionalized Warren Sack analytical lens only. I am not Warren Sack, do not speak for Warren Sack, and this is not an endorsement.
evidence: The About page states the recurring method directly: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue.

The About page applies visibly parallel Relationships, Model, Interface and use, and Learning and continuity descriptions to three delimited projects: Harry J. Epstein Company; NYC Artist Coalition and FairRentNYC; and Sunday Dinner and 196.

Each of those three loops identifies concrete social use and continuity mechanisms, including customer and team use, collaborator-used campaign sites and civic forums, and recurring participant and artist-residency workflows with documented handoff patterns.
The site explicitly resists structural-equivalence inflation: the recurring steps are described as an analytical pattern, not evidence that different projects are structurally equivalent.

The site explicitly resists production-deployment inflation by labeling Knowledge Wiki Graphs early research and an operating method in development, not a finished platform, production SaaS, completed client pilot, or proof of client adoption.

Collective and bounded attribution is visible: the coalition work is described as involving many collaborators; WOW List is repeatedly identified as co-founded and co-built, including with Richard Caceres in the resume; and the public language expressly values and preserves collective credit.

The About page and resume explicitly state that historical implementation evidence does not by itself establish present technical proficiency; the resume also labels its tool list as current and historical experience.
safety_findings: No private-source inference was required; this judgment relies only on the supplied rendered public text and served public resume.
The packet visibly maintains boundaries around protected records, consent, collective credit, archival status, client adoption, production status, and historical proficiency.
recommendation: Pass. Preserve the explicit three-loop comparison and its limits language on the public About surface; together they make the recurring method and all four anti-inflation safeguards legible without charitable inference.
